scope.summary: Implement the retarget engine per Section 13.18 (BK-18.3, TAI-BK-068), closing AREQ-005/019: chain-based mapping (spine chain, limb chains, digit chains) between arbitrary skeletons with an explicit retarget base pose, bake-to-target output, and full headless drivability (REST/MCP-ready typed API, no GUI-only step) — the native answer to Daz Premier's one-click rig conversion.
acceptance_criteria: ChainMap declares source->target chain correspondences (spine, neck/head, arm_l/r, leg_l/r, digit chains, plus optional extension chains) with per-chain rotation offset handling derived from the two skeletons' retarget base poses.

retarget(clip, source_skeleton, target_skeleton, chain_map, base_poses) produces a BodyAnimClip on the target skeleton; a fixture clip retargeted from a Mixamo-convention skeleton onto the canonical BodyKit skeleton keeps feet grounded and hand paths within tolerance (proportion-normalized comparison).
bake_to_target produces plain per-bone keyframes on the target skeleton (no live mapping dependency at playback), deterministic for identical inputs.
Retargeting between different-proportion bodies of the SAME canonical skeleton reuses the same engine (channel-map-aware base poses) — the lane MT-520/521 morph-context re-solve builds on.
The full retarget flow is drivable through a typed headless API with no GUI call in the code path (negative test).
scope.risk_if_missed: Without a real retarget engine, every mocap clip and every cross-skeleton pose asset is locked to one skeleton, and the multi-actor + mocap lanes collapse into manual per-clip conversion — the exact workflow tax that pushes Daz users into Premier subscriptions.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Add source lineage, pose/body hashes, retarget diagnostics, and immutable proposal/application state.
